answer: In a decentralized AI network, the Mesa-based Cipher (DM) mechanism can resist fake-identity attacks. By assigning a unique, ephemeral cipher to each agent, a mesa of interconnected agents verifies identities through a complex network of relationships and interactions, much like a nebula of entangled particles. An attacker attempting to create multiple identities must now maintain a stable web of relationships, increasing computational costs and susceptibility to detection.
